prompts.title: Ritmo de forma
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, 6–10 seconds. Editorial variant: kinetic typography on GoatLab charcoal #101412. Headline in warm white #edf0e6 condensed uppercase: "FORMA RECIENTE". The Spanish team names «Manchester City FC» and «Ipswich Town FC» slam in line by line with rhythmic emphasis: each word scales from 1.15 to 1.0 on a hard ease-out, letters offset by two frames, while a lime #c5ed74 underline wipes left to right. Punch the results as oversized kinetic words — «VICTORIAS», «EMPATES», «DERROTAS» — each entering on a drum hit, with the numerals resolving from a blurred glyph scramble. Alternating slate #8ca6bf for Ipswich keeps one focal point: the winning count in lime. No statistical axes here. Entry: charcoal field, a thin lime vertical bar grows from bottom to top in the upper half. Main motion: words stack and lock, emphasis pulses scale 1.06 on the strongest line for three frames, then a slate diagonal wipe is the transition. Exit: type slides up behind a mask. Camera: subtle push-in from 1.00 to 1.06 across the whole scene. Keep the lower quarter free for permanent yellow subtitles. Spanish labels throughout.

Statistical variant: same 9:16 frame, a grouped count bar chart with a shared zero baseline in the upper two thirds. Three groups — «VICTORIAS», «EMPATES», «DERROTAS» — each holding a Manchester City bar in lime and an Ipswich bar in slate, heights from {{home.wins}}, {{home.draws}}, {{home.losses}}, {{away.wins}}, {{away.draws}}, {{away.losses}} in units of partidos. Two sample annotations sit under each team key: muestra de {{home.n}} partidos and muestra de {{away.n}} partidos, both equal so no unequal-sample warning is needed; the source line reads «Fuente: Bzzoiro · source fixtures lastMatches». Typography: condensed warm white axis labels at 32 units, numerals inside bar caps at 40 units lime. Entry: baseline draws in 0.4s, then bars grow from zero staggered 0.12s with cubic ease-out. Main comparison: paired bars resolve side by side. Emphasis: a lime hairline brackets the largest gap. Camera holds static; the transition is a horizontal wipe; exit fades the chart while the source note lingers one beat. Lower quarter reserved for yellow subtitles. Spanish labels only.

prompts.title: Balance de goles
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, 6–10 seconds. Editorial variant: an illustrative football pitch drawn in slate #8ca6bf hairlines on charcoal #101412, viewed slightly isometric. Headline in warm white #edf0e6: «GOLES». A lime #c5ed74 ball travels along an animated dashed path from the centre circle into the net, the net rippling on impact, then a second path arcs back — reading as attack and concession without claiming any specific match event. Spanish team names «Manchester City FC» and «Ipswich Town FC» sit as labels on either half. A large kinetic counter of the team's attacking tally resolves from a rolling glyph blur into place with a lime glow, echoed by a slate counter below. Entry: pitch lines stroke-draw over 0.6s. Main motion: ball paths play twice with a rhythmic bounce on each arrival; emphasis: the leading numeral scales 1.12 and flashes lime for four frames. Camera: slow tilt from centre spot upward. Transition: a soft lime wipe crossing the pitch; exit: ball rolls off the top edge pulling the type with it. Lower quarter permanently free for yellow subtitles; Spanish labels used. No statistical axes in this variant.

Statistical variant: paired bars on a shared scale in the upper two thirds, warm white condensed type. Two bar pairs: «Goles a favor» ({{home.gf}} vs {{away.gf}}) and «Goles recibidos» ({{home.ga}}, {{away.ga}}), unit goles, Manchester City in lime, Ipswich in slate, common zero baseline and identical scale so both pairs are directly readable. Beneath each team key, the sample note appears literally: muestra de {{home.n}} partidos and muestra de {{away.n}} partidos, with the source line «Fuente: Bzzoiro · source fixtures lastMatches». Subtitle: «Balance ofensivo de los últimos partidos». Entry: grid baseline and unit label «goles» fade in, bars grow from zero staggered 0.1s. Main comparison: the favour pair resolves first, the conceded pair 0.6s later. Emphasis: a lime bracket spans the widest difference. Camera static; transition is a vertical shutter wipe; exit slides bars down behind a mask while the source note stays one beat. Lower quarter reserved for yellow subtitles. All Spanish labels.

prompts.title: Arcos en cero
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, 6–10 seconds. Editorial variant: defensive energy built around a stylised shield — a geometric outline in slate #8ca6bf on charcoal #101412 that assembles from three chevrons locking together with a metallic snap. Headline in warm white #edf0e6: «DEFENSA». Spanish team names «Manchester City FC» and «Ipswich Town FC» flank the shield as stacked labels. Concentric lime #c5ed74 rings pulse outward from the shield like saved shots deflecting, each ring emitted on a beat and fading over half a second; a small lime keyline traces the shield perimeter. Entry: chevrons fly in from left, top and right, locking in 0.7s. Main motion: rings pulse three times with growing radius; emphasis: the shield core flashes lime for five frames on the final pulse. Camera: gentle push-in from 1.00 to 1.05. Transition: a shield-shaped iris wipe covers the frame; exit: shield breaks apart into horizontal bars sliding off. Lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles; Spanish labels. No axes, sample claims or invented match events in this variant.

Statistical variant: two vertical count bars on a shared zero baseline in the upper half, unit partidos, heights from {{home.clean}} (lime) and {{away.clean}} (slate), identical scale, condensed warm white type, heading «Arcos en cero». Explicit sample notes beneath each bar: muestra de {{home.n}} partidos and muestra de {{away.n}} partidos — counts are shown as counts, never converted into rates. Source annotation: «Fuente: Bzzoiro · source fixtures lastMatches». Entry: baseline and unit label draw in over 0.35s, bars grow from zero with 0.15s stagger. Main comparison: both bars rise together so the viewer reads the gap directly; because the Ipswich value is zero, a labelled hollow placeholder outline marked «0» in slate keeps the category visible rather than empty. Emphasis: a lime bracket and hairline callout frame the taller bar. Camera static; transition is a lime wipe from the shield's left edge; exit fades bars while the sample note remains one beat. Lower quarter kept clear for yellow subtitles. Spanish labels throughout.

prompts.title: Duelo de cruces
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, 6–10 seconds. Editorial variant: a visual duel on charcoal #101412. A vertical lime #c5ed74 seam splits the frame; «Manchester City FC» enters from the left in warm white #edf0e6 condensed uppercase, «Ipswich Town FC» from the right, both sliding in with a two-frame overshoot and a hard shake on impact at the seam. Each side carries a large shield-less crest block: lime on the left, slate #8ca6bf on the right, scaling from 0.8 to 1.0. Headline above the seam: «ENFRENTAMIENTOS DIRECTOS». Between them, three thin horizontal tally bars rest at the centre like a scoreboard ribbon. Entry: seam draws downward in 0.4s. Main motion: the two names collide twice with a rhythmic nudge; emphasis: a lime flare crosses the seam on the second impact. Camera: subtle lateral drift left then right to sell the duel, amplitude small. Transition: the seam widens into a lime vertical wipe; exit: both names slide out along the seam. Lower quarter permanently free for yellow subtitles; Spanish labels used. No axes or sample claims in this variant, and this history is presented as past record only.

Statistical variant: a horizontal stacked bar of the historical record, unit partidos, on a shared zero baseline spanning the upper half — segments sized from {{h2h.homeWins}} in lime (labeled «Manchester City FC · victorias»), {{h2h.awayWins}} in slate («Ipswich Town FC · victorias»), and {{h2h.draws}} in warm white («Empates»), summing to the total shown as a header: «Cruces previos: {{h2h.total}} partidos». Both team segments carry the identical sample note: muestra de {{h2h.total}} partidos; source annotation reads «Fuente: Bzzoiro · source fixtures h2h». Caption in Spanish: «Datos históricos, no son una predicción». Entry: baseline and total counter draw in over 0.4s, segments grow from left staggered 0.1s. Main comparison: segments meet at the seam. Emphasis: lime bracket over the leading segment. Camera static; transition is a vertical wipe; exit slides segments left while the caption and sample note hold one beat. Lower quarter reserved for yellow subtitles.

prompts.title: Tensión goleadora
prompts.prompt:
9:16 vertical, 6–10 seconds. Editorial variant: team reveals with narrative emphasis on charcoal #101412. Sequence opens with a full-frame lime #c5ed74 slash; «MANCHESTER CITY FC» reveals behind a rising mask in warm white #edf0e6 condensed uppercase, followed by the two Spanish scorer labels «Erling Haaland» and «Rayan Cherki» typing on word by word with a lime keyline underlining each name for four frames. Then a slate #8ca6bf slash cuts across; «IPSWICH TOWN FC» reveals the same way, followed by «Emersonn» and «Leif Davis» with slate keylines. Centered headline bridges the halves: «GOLEADORES». Entry: slash sweeps in 0.35s. Main motion: each reveal is a mask wipe plus a 1.05 scale pop; emphasis: a single large numeral per name fades up from blur with a lime glow on the City side and slate glow on the Ipswich side. Camera: slow push-in 1.00 to 1.05 with a slight vertical parallax on the type layers. Transition: horizontal bar wipe alternating lime and slate; exit: both names blocks slide upward behind masks. Lower quarter permanently reserved for yellow subtitles; Spanish labels throughout. No axes in this variant.

Statistical variant: two paired bar groups in the upper two thirds, shared zero baseline, common scale, unit goles. Left group «Manchester City FC» with bars from {{home.player0.goals}} (lime) and {{home.player1.goals}} (lime at reduced opacity), labeled «Erling Haaland» and «Rayan Cherki». Right group «Ipswich Town FC» with {{away.player0.goals}} and {{away.player1.goals}} in slate, labeled «Emersonn» and «Leif Davis». Cross-group comparison stays valid because the unit is identical. Source annotation sits directly under the chart: «Fuente: Tabla de goleadores · source scorers premier»; no sample size is claimed for this source, so no sample note is printed. Spanish caption: «Máximos goleadores disponibles». Entry: baseline and unit label fade in 0.3s, bars grow staggered 0.1s. Main comparison: City group resolves first, Ipswich group 0.5s later. Emphasis: lime bracket over the tallest bar. Camera static; transition is a lime wipe; exit fades bars while the source note holds one beat. Lower quarter kept clear for yellow subtitles.
